requirements.quote: BGP messages are sent over TCP connections.
requirements.required_behavior: Send BGP messages over TCP connections.
requirements.why_checkable: The transport used to carry BGP messages is directly inspectable.

requirements.quote:
A message is processed
   only after it is entirely received.
requirements.required_behavior: Process the message only after the entire message has been received.
requirements.why_checkable: Fragmented TCP input can establish whether message processing waits for complete reception.

requirements.quote:
The maximum message size is 4096
   octets.
requirements.required_behavior: Limit the total message size to 4096 octets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Use a BGP message larger than 4096 octets.
requirements.why_checkable: Message length bounds are concrete encoding and parsing checks.

requirements.quote:
All implementations are required to support this maximum
   message size.
requirements.condition: for a BGP message of the specified maximum size, 4096 octets
requirements.why_checkable: A valid message at the maximum size tests implementation capacity.

requirements.quote:
The smallest message that may be sent consists of a
   BGP header without a data portion (19 octets).
requirements.required_behavior: Use a minimum total message size of 19 octets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Send a message shorter than 19 octets.
requirements.why_checkable: The minimum encoded message length is measurable.

requirements.quote:
The smallest message that may be sent consists of a
   BGP header without a data portion (19 octets).
requirements.required_behavior: Permit a message consisting solely of a BGP header, with no data portion.
requirements.why_checkable: Header-only message support can be checked independently of the length lower bound.

requirements.quote: All multi-octet fields are in network byte order.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode and decode multi-octet fields in network byte order.
requirements.why_checkable: Field byte order can be checked with known wire values.
